newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: De Boer, Unigro sees clear rise in 97 EPS.
newsitem.headline: De Boer, Unigro sees clear rise in 97 EPS.

text.p: Supermarkets group De Boer Winkelbedrijven NV and wholesale retailer Unigro said on Tuesday their merged De Boer Unigro group expected to book a clear rise in net earnings per share (EPS) in 1997.

"The prognosis for 1997 (is) a clear increase in net results per share in De Boer-Unigro," the companies said in a joint statement giving further details of their planned merger, due to be approved by shareholders on May 28 and retroactive to January 1, 1997.
The firms said they planned a five-for-two stock split after the merger, which will be effected by means of a share swap.
Under the terms of the merger all Unigro shares will transferred to De Boer, which will subsequently place 6.05 million new shares plus one million warrants with Unigro's original shareholder.
After the merger, this Unigro holding company will own some 57 percent of outstanding De Boer Unigro shares, which it will reduce to 49.9 percent at most within six months.
